reason: Ten stores minimum on a 12-month contract is almost a million pesos a year, and nobody has used this yet. I don't see 7-Eleven or Alfamart doing it, and my supplier reps already help me with displays for free.
objection: A new company with zero customer results wants me to lock in for a year. If the simulation is wrong, I've paid for a full year of nothing and I can't get out.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a big chain like 7-Eleven or Alfamart using it with real sales lift, plus a short paid pilot on 2-3 stores without a 12-month lock-in.
